editorial:
Imagine moving into a brand new home and thinking you finally have a fresh start with your kids. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow a tired mom and her two children who are just trying to settle in. Everything seems fine until one night when the mom has to step out and leave the kids by themselves. At first, it looks like a fun night of games and snacks, but the mood shifts fast. You will feel the tension build as the house starts to feel like a trap, and the kids realize they are not actually alone in the building. It is a scary ride that makes you think twice about leaving your children home alone.

The acting is great, especially the kids, who make you truly care about what happens to them. The twists are surprising and the movie moves along quickly so you never get bored. Some parts might feel a bit too intense if you are squeamish, but that is why you love horror. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go. It is a perfect pick for a spooky movie night with friends.
endingExplained: You find out that the house is built on an old site where a family disappeared years ago. The spirits of those children trick the siblings into opening a locked basement door. In the final scene, the mom rushes home just in time to save her youngest child from being pulled into the walls. They escape the house and leave everything behind, but the final shot shows the basement door slowly closing on its own.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrillers and jump scares.
